name: Yuutenji Masachika
source:
He is the head of the Yuutenji family, a prestigious family with ample financial resources. He is a spoiled brat who spends his days with no shortage of girls.

He was forbidden by Maria to impregnate women, but after purchasing Myourenji Girl's Academy, he is now able to impregnate as many women as he wants. 

He is able to love all women with his open-mindedness.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/haramase/index.html]official site[/url]]
